title: Multi-Signal Adaptive Search Controller v1
goal: Use one explicit uncertainty signal to coordinate several selective-search mechanisms instead of tuning each mechanism independently.

observations: Current Stockfish has root bestMoveChanges, but uses that signal for time management rather than as a unified controller for LMR, razoring, futility and null-move pruning.
Current Stockfish has many adaptive pruning/reduction heuristics, but no explicit uncertainty/confidence or policy head was found in the current code search.

Current Stockfish already uses evaluation history, TT state, correction history and root score statistics separately; FAYE-0008-v1 combines disagreement and root-instability signals into one typed controller output.
novelty_audit.historical_caution: This is an experimental engineering novelty claim only. Do not claim literature-level novelty until a broader historical Stockfish/Fishtest audit is completed.
research_context: Risk management in game-tree pruning (Information Sciences, 2000): motivates explicit risk assessment for forward pruning.
Searching with Uncertainty Cut-Offs (ICGA Journal, 1997): historical precedent for treating uncertainty as a search-control concept.
Recent neural-chess work on learned planning/policy representations motivates eventually learning the controller signal, but v1 intentionally stays deterministic and CPU-only.

design_rules: High uncertainty makes pruning/reduction more conservative.
Low uncertainty permits mildly more aggressive pruning/reduction.
No dynamic allocation in the hot path.
No NNUE format change in v1.
All controller math is integer-only and uses signals already produced by search.

screen.bench_policy: Bench nodes may change because this is a functional search change; benchmark determinism within each binary is still required.

decision_policy: This screen is exploratory. A positive screen is not enough for merge; require a larger independent confirmation and ablations showing which controller channels contribute.
next_if_positive: Run larger normalized-SPRT confirmation, then ablate LMR/futility/NMP/razoring channels independently before any promotion.
next_if_negative: Keep the architecture scaffold, revise controller signal/weights, and run v2 rather than returning to unrelated micro-patches.
